Idiomorph 0.7.3 (https://github.com/bigskysoftware/idiomorph), 0BSD.

Vendored byte-for-byte from npm:
  idiomorph@0.7.3  dist/idiomorph.min.js -> idiomorph.min.js

  source:  https://unpkg.com/idiomorph@0.7.3/dist/idiomorph.min.js
  sha256:  8a7733fadfa0d3dae533fd80483c640885221c93458c1711c940797508f46662
  bytes:   9346

Used by the console's streamed artifact preview (ADR 0118 D3, S8): the host inlines this
file as the single nonce'd script in the preview frame's srcdoc, where a tiny receiver applies
Idiomorph.morph() to the processed partial markup posted on each update, so the preview updates
in place instead of being rebuilt. The file is unmodified; before inlining, the host escapes any
`</script` sequence (there are none at this version) so it cannot close its host <script> early.
